files.dependencyDirection: Server-only persistence may depend on stable referral types, pure policy, database adapters, and workflow policy; server routes and services may depend on its public API. Browser modules must not gain runtime imports from it.
files.purpose: Selects and implements referral persistence, queries, mutation policy, audit construction, duplicate review, trash and restore, and referral-coupled work-item and assessment effects.
callers: Referral, trash, file, search, activity, assessment, workflow, operations, calendar, health, and reconciliation routes and services
sideEffects: Local JSON reads and atomic replacement with process-global state
PostgreSQL referral, people, work-item, assessment, idempotency, audit, and revision reads and writes
files.failureBehavior: Returns typed conflicts, blockers, or null for expected outcomes and throws for duplicate, capacity, cursor, race, database, and local persistence failures. PostgreSQL coupled effects roll back transactionally; local cross-store effects are intentionally not equivalent.

staticPrompts.prompt: Large module (3233 lines): split by behavior before adding more responsibilities.
staticPrompts.reason: The module contains separable contracts, adapter selection, two adapters, queries, mappings, mutation policy, audit construction, projections, and cross-store synchronization. Iteration one moves only two pure type declarations.
staticPrompts.followUp: Future responsibility moves require their own characterized iteration.

staticPrompts.prompt: Contains runtime console logging; verify messages cannot include PHI, tokens, query strings, or upstream bodies.
staticPrompts.reason: The local-load warning uses fixed service and event fields and does not interpolate the exception or referral data.
staticPrompts.followUp: Retain aggregate-only logging in later adapter work.

staticPrompts.prompt: Explicitly suppresses a rejected promise; verify this is genuinely optional and observable.
staticPrompts.reason: The persistence queue recovers a prior rejected state before its next serialized write; this iteration does not touch the queue or weaken rejection of the failed command.
staticPrompts.followUp: Characterize operator-visible local persistence readiness before any queue extraction.

files.decisionReason: Move the two pure mutation shapes to the existing stable type owner and preserve store re-exports. Defer every runtime split.

files.dependencyDirection: Stable domain and mutation shapes may depend only on stable domain vocabularies and type-only contracts; application, policy, persistence, route, and browser layers may depend on them.
files.purpose: Defines canonical referral, ownership, section, workflow, requirement, decision, handoff, assessment-projection, and file shapes shared across Pipeline.
callers: Referral store, workflow, assessment, operations, calendar, activity, validation, API routes, and browser components
files.failureBehavior: Type-only module; incompatible shapes fail TypeScript and production-build checks without runtime effects.
files.decisionReason: Reuse the existing stable type owner for the two pure mutation shapes; do not broaden it into a general infrastructure contract.

files.dependencyDirection: Pure public-input validation may depend on canonical referral types and bounded vocabulary constants; it must not depend on storage, routes, browser code, or external services.
files.purpose: Validates referral create and public patch payloads, including server-owned fields, limits, enums, hashes, documents, projections, work items, decisions, and timestamps.
files.failureBehavior: Returns a bounded public validation failure before a route invokes persistence.
files.decisionReason: Keep validation as the trust boundary while changing its type-only dependency from the effectful store to the stable type owner.

files.dependencyDirection: Pure optimistic-section policy may depend on referral field and section types; routes, collaboration UI, workflow, and stores may depend on it.
files.purpose: Maps mutable referral fields to optimistic-concurrency sections and owns defaults, normalization, incrementing, classification, and section-name validation.
callers: Referral item route, packet canvas, referral store, and workflow store
files.failureBehavior: Malformed or missing section-version input normalizes to defaults; unsupported patch keys claim no section and callers own conflict responses.
files.decisionReason: It already owns one cohesive pure policy and remains unchanged in iteration one.

files.dependencyDirection: Governance documentation may cite approved repository evidence and controls but has no runtime dependents.
files.purpose: Records the owner-authorized architecture understanding, scope, invariants, failure behavior, and proof boundary for this slice.
files.failureBehavior: An incomplete or stale narrative fails the refactor start review; it has no runtime failure mode.
files.decisionReason: The playbook requires a durable, exact-start architecture record.

files.dependencyDirection: Governance data may cite the repository inventory and active slice; only refactor validators consume it.
files.purpose: Records the disposition, side effects, tests, and exact static concerns for every scoped or explicitly allowlisted file.
files.failureBehavior: Missing files, prompts, metadata, or scope dispositions fail the active-slice quality gate.
files.decisionReason: The active refactor gate requires one exact file-audit disposition.
